runtime_comparison.scope: Compiler output comparison; export timestamp normalized, debug sections excluded. Source/value-flow proof does not require byte matching.

current_loop_lifetimes.scope: Conservative reaching definitions separate nonescaping ordinary int value groups. Shared reads and read/modify/write uses merge groups; entry/uninitialized and opaque-write groups cannot acquire names. Each renamed group has an induction role and direct non-inline native int32 local vocabulary. Independent induction components have explicit initialization, unit updates and loop comparison uses; player-index vocabulary is supported by player-argument uses. C member names retain their separate namespace and ordinary identifiers cannot be captured. Merging the new bindings reproduces every predecessor byte. All actual expanded units match. Native optimized-variable identity and new function coverage are not claimed; no gameplay tests.

focused.scope: Fresh focused loop-lifetime validation and exact predecessor input compatibility. Earlier semantic checkers and the full historical suite were not rerun.

validation.limits: Readability recovery of accepted bodies, not new function coverage. Conservative reaching definitions preserve old int reads and keep read/modify/write values in one scalar component. Explicit initialization, unit updates and loop comparisons support induction roles; player-argument uses support player vocabulary. All87 actual expansions and36 ASSERT sites pass, with372 direct native int32 local references. Exact inverse merging reproduces predecessor bytes. Code/data differences are recorded without requiring byte matching. Historical compiler/runtime replay was retired during artifact pruning; current batch/source/build verification passes; no gameplay tests.
